blocking_findings.title: CONFIRM_CODING lacks the required privileged human confirmation
blocking_findings.trigger: After a valid PREPARE, a same-origin renderer invokes the exposed codingConfirm IPC directly without pressing the visible button or accepting any user dialog.
blocking_findings.observed: The final bound IPC handler invokes manager.confirmCoding immediately; one CONFIRM_CODING frame with the main-held original request id/hash is sent and CODING_CONFIGURED returned. The only confirmation is renderer window.confirm. No privileged main-process dialog or independent consent gate exists.
blocking_findings.impact: Renderer code can cause persistent workspace coding authorization without the required human review and privileged confirmation of that frozen scope. Hiding request id/hash does not prevent this because the no-argument confirm endpoint supplies them.
blocking_findings.repair: Require main-process-owned explicit confirmation showing the exact frozen workspace, relative paths/checks/limits and selected resource identities. Cancellation must send zero CONFIRM. After the awaited native dialog, recheck original host/process/context/resource generation and shared pending state before consuming and sending the original request. Renderer-controlled booleans or window.confirm are insufficient.
blocking_findings.scope_requirement: CP424: human frozen result review followed by explicit privileged confirmation.

blocking_findings.title: Expired coding intent is retired before the shared pending-command guard
blocking_findings.trigger: An unconfirmed coding request expires by real wall-clock time and original STATUS confirms EXPIRED. A second STATUS remains in flight; another codingPrepare IPC arrives while that shared private command is pending.
blocking_findings.observed: prepareCoding appends the original intent to retiredCodingIntents and sets codingIntent=null before exchange checks pending. It then throws MANAGEMENT_COMMAND_PENDING. The late STATUS resolves its captured old object while codingSummary now reports READY; subsequent original STATUS fails CODING_ORIGINAL_REQUEST_REQUIRED.
blocking_findings.impact: The shared barrier blocks the new frame only after the active original request has already been discarded. Original-request recovery is unavailable while a coding/private operation is still unresolved, violating the same-pipe retention contract.
blocking_findings.repair: Check the single shared pending/uncertain barrier before any coding or qualification retirement or scope mutation. Keep the original intent active until the original terminal response is handled and all retirement conditions are revalidated; preserve consumed requests and historical evidence.
blocking_findings.scope_requirement: CP424: shared coding/qualification/shutdown pending barrier; preserve uncertain/original intents and late status.
blocking_findings.test_clock: Synthetic original response had 400 ms remaining lifetime; actual 450 ms wait used. No clock mocking or expiry-field mutation.

blocking_findings.title: A context change during PREPARE loses the returned original request
blocking_findings.trigger: PREPARE_CODING is sent for session-1, selection changes to session-2 before the original valid response arrives, and later the user returns to session-1.
blocking_findings.observed: The response resolves the shared pending operation, then sameContext throws before storing request_id/hash. codingIntent is null, retiredCodingIntents is empty, and no pending operation remains. Returning to session-1 cannot STATUS the original request and can send a second PREPARE while the first remains unexpired.
blocking_findings.impact: The original frozen request is orphaned by an ordinary selection race; renderer remount cannot recover it, and the required original-request retained state is lost.
blocking_findings.repair: Retain an operation record before dispatch, validate and store the original response independently from whether the current UI selection can use it, and expose a blocked context state rather than discarding original id/hash. A second PREPARE must not bypass the original retirement/recovery policy.
blocking_findings.scope_requirement: CP424: changed host/session/writer/resource choice fails closed with original request retained.

blocking_findings.title: STATUS recovery of a committed configuration does not refresh the original V2 views
blocking_findings.trigger: CONFIRM has an uncertain/lost response. Explicit codingStatus then returns the original CODING_CONFIGURED result with the new model configuration.
blocking_findings.observed: The final bound React component displays CODING_CONFIGURED, but onConfigured is called only when method===codingConfirm. Actual Chromium recorded confirms=1, refreshes=0 after STATUS recovery, with no page errors.
blocking_findings.impact: The recovery path reports the new configuration while leaving the workbench host/configuration views on their earlier snapshot until some separate refresh. The explicit refresh promised after the original coding commit is missing on the path intended for lost replies.
blocking_findings.repair: Reconcile any authoritative original CODING_CONFIGURED result, including STATUS, through the original V2 view refresh without resending CONFIRM. Bind reconciliation to original host/project/session/generation and avoid applying the result to a changed selection.
blocking_findings.scope_requirement: CP424: refresh original V2 session/configuration only after committed new config.

tests.note: Counterexample exit code zero means asserted defects were reproduced; it is not a product PASS.

author_evidence.interpretation: Original 203-case log and one synthetic DOM pass do not cover these four negative paths. The no-install Electron smoke is not an installed managed-Core success.

reviewed_positive_boundaries: Main restricts renderer field names to path/check/limit intent (the Core private contract validates relative-path values); trusted main derives selected project/session/model, desktop client id, current writer epoch/revision/workspace and host head plus one. Absolute toolchain/vendor paths are selected through native directory dialogs and kept in main.

Private request id/hash and authority fields stay in main; codingSummary exposes reduced human scope. Confirm marks confirmSent before sending, so timeout and repeated direct confirmation cannot issue a second CONFIRM.

The existing exchange retains uncertain pending state and checks native host/process identity pre/post response; coding IPC recomputes a current summary after awaiting an action. New retirement and prepare-response paths nevertheless lose original state as reproduced.
Startup stderr capture is bounded to 8192 bytes in privileged main; smoke output exposes only bytes/hash/truncation. No new renderer raw diagnostic channel was found.
Coding results preserve REGISTERED and model_calls=0; independent qualification remains a separate operation. Source/fixture results do not qualify model transport or tool execution.
limitations: No integrated Core-native coding coupling, full installed Electron first-use, real model/tool execution, protected holdout or formal W05 acceptance.
